hook.en: The principal asks: how many students scored less than 30, and how many scored 30 or more? A cumulative frequency table answers in one glance.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರಾಂಶುಪಾಲರು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ: 30ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ, 30 ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ? ಸಂಚಿತ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಒಂದೇ ನೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Construct less-than and more-than cumulative frequency distributions
Read answers from a cumulative table

narration.en: The principal asks: how many students scored less than 30, and how many scored 30 or more? A cumulative frequency table answers in one glance.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರಾಂಶುಪಾಲರು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ: 30ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ, 30 ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ? ಸಂಚಿತ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಒಂದೇ ನೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The less-than cumulative frequency of a class is the number of observations below its upper boundary: add the frequencies from the top. The more-than cumulative frequency is the number of observations at or above its lower boundary: add from the bottom. The last less-than cf and the first more-than cf both equal N.
body.kn: ಕಡಿಮೆ-ಸಂಚಿತ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ: ಮೇಲ್ಗಡಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ; ಮೇಲಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು-ಸಂಚಿತ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ: ಕೆಳಗಡಿ ಅಥವಾ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇರುವವು; ಕೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. ಕೊನೆಯ ಕಡಿಮೆ-cf ಮತ್ತು ಮೊದಲ ಹೆಚ್ಚು-cf ಎರಡೂ N.

points.en: Less than: add from the top, against upper boundaries
More than: add from the bottom, against lower boundaries

say.en: Marks of 40 students in five classes.
Less than: keep adding from the top. 4, then 4 plus 6 is 10, then 20, 32 and 40.
More than: add from the bottom. 8, then 20, 30, 36 and 40 at the top.
Read off: 20 students scored below 30, and 20 scored 30 or more.

narration.en: On the board: Building cumulative frequencies.

body.en: Relative frequency of a class = f/N; it shows the share of the class in the total and lets us compare distributions with different N. Percentage frequency = f/N × 100. The relative frequencies add up to 1.
body.kn: ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ = f/N; ಶೇಕಡಾ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ = f/N × 100. ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ N ಇರುವ ವಿತರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯಕ. ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ 1.

caption.en: Set the frequencies of four classes of marks. The bars are the less-than cumulative frequencies: they never fall, and the last bar is N.

tryThis.en: Can a less-than cumulative bar ever be shorter than the one before it?
Make exactly half the students score below 20.

narration.en: Set the frequencies of four classes of marks. The bars are the less-than cumulative frequencies: they never fall, and the last bar is N.

problem.en: Marks: 0–10: 4, 10–20: 6, 20–30: 10, 30–40: 12, 40–50: 8. Form less-than and more-than cumulative frequencies, and find the relative frequency of 30–40.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Marks: 0–10: 4, 10–20: 6, 20–30: 10, 30–40: 12, 40–50: 8. Form less-than and more-than cumulative frequencies, and find the relative frequency of 30–40.

body.en: Less-than cf goes up to N at the bottom; more-than cf starts at N at the top. If they do not, you have added wrongly.

narration.en: Less-than climbs, more-than falls. Less-than cf goes up to N at the bottom; more-than cf starts at N at the top. If they do not, you have added wrongly.

mnemonic.en: Less → Last is N; More → first is N

narration.en: Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions of the kind asked in the first PUC Statistics annual examination.

points.en: Less-than cf: add from the top; against upper boundaries.
More-than cf: add from the bottom; against lower boundaries.
Last less-than cf = first more-than cf = N.

homework.en: Form both cumulative frequency distributions for: 10–20: 3, 20–30: 7, 30–40: 15, 40–50: 10, 50–60: 5.

narration.en: Recap. Less-than cf: add from the top; against upper boundaries. More-than cf: add from the bottom; against lower boundaries. Last less-than cf = first more-than cf = N. Relative frequency = f/N.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಡಿಮೆ-cf: ಮೇಲಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ; ಮೇಲ್ಗಡಿಗಳ ಎದುರು. ಹೆಚ್ಚು-cf: ಕೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ; ಕೆಳಗಡಿಗಳ ಎದುರು. ಕೊನೆಯ ಕಡಿಮೆ-cf = ಮೊದಲ ಹೆಚ್ಚು-cf = N. ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ = f/N.
